info.name: Adobe Campaign Classic Custom Resources API
Adobe Campaign List Profile-linked Custom Resources

params.name: cusResourceName
params.description: The name of the custom resource (with cus prefix, e.g., cusMyResource).

params.name: _lineCount
params.description: Number of records to return per page. Default is 25.

params.name: _lineStart
params.description: Pagination offset from the next node in previous response.

params.name: _order
params.description: Sort order. Use field name for ascending, append %20desc for descending (e.g., email%20desc).

items.docs: Retrieves records from a profile-linked custom resource. Custom resources are defined with the cus prefix in Campaign Standard.

info.name: Adobe Campaign List Non-profile Custom Resources

params.name: cusResourceName
params.description: The name of the custom resource.

params.name: _lineCount
params.description: Number of records to return per page. Default is 25.

params.name: _lineStart
params.description: Pagination offset from the next node in previous response.

params.name: _order
params.description: Sort order. Use field name for ascending, append %20desc for descending (e.g., email%20desc).

items.docs: Retrieves records from a standalone custom resource not linked to profiles.
